_about: Optional settings for online play, read when someone hosts or joins. Edit this file on the web space, no rebuild needed. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Anything you leave out uses the built in default. Address bar options (?broker=, ?ice=, ?relay=1, ?relay=wss://host/, ?transport=) win over this file. "relay" is the wss:// address of the relay server (README, Relay server): set it for players who cannot connect peer to peer. See the README, Multiplayer section.
